reviews.text: So had my two Pomeranian girls here last week,the 2girls that carried out the grooms were absolutely amazing,I have never witnessed my dogs looking so perfectly groomed,they look absolutely amazing,the girls were very talented and I wont be taking my girls anywhere else again...thank you beauty and the beast you are amazing and bonnie&bambam look beautiful 😍
Amazing service from everyone for the past year and half. Such a shame we are moving away. So attentive to my nervous dog but now she runs straight in to the bath area.
Our dog is really temperamental but the team handled him so well, and his groom looks brilliant, despite the issues they had with him. Would certainly recommend
took my cookie to them she looks amazing the staff were fantasic with her the staff were polite and amazing  cant praise them enough
Absoulte gem of a place...Needed my dogs nails doing and also a good bath...Managed to get her in at the end of the day...Superb ...Cannot recommend enough....Thank you ladies...

Can’t praise the staff that work at the dog grooming highly enough! Since day one I’m incredibly pleased with the attention to detail, the grooming and their ability to devote 110% attention to each individual dog and its needs. It’s also very satisfying when they remember they regulars name and how we like to have our pooch groomed and her medical needs. In short I’m nothing but incredibly pleased we discovered such a gem of a place! Keep up the good work and we sure will be back shortly with our very vocal performer, Callie!
Lovely place. The ladies was so friendly and looked after my brothers dog great. He was so happy when we picked him up. They are very professional thankyou. great service

I can’t recommend Beauty and Beast highly enough! They’ve done an absolutely fantastic job grooming my one-year-old black poodle. From the moment we walked in, the team was warm, professional, and clearly passionate about what they do.

“Sparky looked incredible after his session—his coat is glossy, neatly trimmed, and he smelled wonderful too. They handled the boy who can be quite difficult with such care and attention, and it’s clear they understand how to work with energetic young dogs. He came out looking like a show dog, and more importantly,  he was happy and relaxed.

I’ll be sharing some photos alongside this review so you can see the transformation for yourself—he’s never looked better!

Highly recommended for anyone looking for top-quality grooming and kind, knowledgeable staff. I have already booked him in again!
Cheers Michael in Crossgates.
Well done The Beauty and the Beast. 🐩🥰
I took my dog in to get her nails done, the girls were so lovely and reassuring and did a brilliant job, thank you!

This place is amazing. I would highly recommend 👌 My Cockapoo has been here a few times now. He's currently at that teenage difficult age. I was a bit worried about his behaviour before he went yesterday. He does not like being told what to do! The staff are fantastic and my dog came out looking and smelling amazing. He even got a snazzy new bandana! Me and my dog rate this place 5  ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Amazing service couldn’t do enough for my teddy very professional and friendly I would definitely recommend I’d give more stars if I could
Visitied for the first time, was great from start to finish with Pebbles my nervous yorkshire terrier. She settled nicely and looks great. Thank you
First time bringing our alfie & have to say they were fantastic. He looked great afterwards & would not take him anywhere else now. They were so good with him. Would highly recommend 👍 …

Amazing dog groomers all around. The best by far! and we’ve tried a lot of groomers in Leeds and never been as pleased with the outcome. Just can't get over how gorgeous our dog looks. Would highly recommend❤️

Came once for a quick nail clipping and then came again for a full groom & the Prince Charming spa package. Couldn't have asked for anything better for my lovely greyhound! The staff there are absolutely wonderful and absolutely love Stripe 💚 would recommend to anyone & everyone! …

We tried B&tB after being repeatedly dissapointed by another groomer and from a few word of mouth recommendations from the owners of well groomed dogs in the park.

The care, attention and pride Ellie takes in her work is phenomenal and the quality of the groom was excellent. All our comments and requests were listened to and our miniature labradoodle was very relaxed and happy when we returned to collect, so she obviously was well looked after by the staff who are incredibly friendly and have a genuine love for dogs.

Would highly recommend and will definitely be returning for our next groom - an easy 5 stars, thank you Ellie!
The loveliest people who will put you at ease leaving your dog there. Very skilled dog groomers giving Remy a fabulous cut and leaving him looking very handsome.

Luna was very nervous for her first grooming experience but the wonderful people here made her feel so comfortable, I was instantly confident to leave her in their hands. Luna had a wonderful pampering, I opted for an additional spa …
